info.title: QCI Samar API Documentation
info.description:
API documentation for QCI Samar Backend

## Case Convention: camelCase

This API uses **camelCase** for all request and response JSON keys.

```

get.description: Retrieves all punch-in and punch-out records for an assessment, including a summary showing current status of each team member.

summary.description: Summary of each team member's attendance status

post.description: Records a punch-in for the current user. Requires a selfie image with GPS coordinates. User must be a team member of the assessment and not already punched in.

recordedAt.description: Device capture time of the punch (required — stored as recorded_at; never defaults to server time)

clientUuid.description: Idempotency key — a replay with the same value returns the already-recorded punch

message.example: You have already punched in. Please punch out first.
You are not a team member of this assessment

409.description: The punch key is already in use by another record

post.description: Records a punch-out for the current user. User must have punched in first.

recordedAt.description: Device capture time of the punch (required — stored as recorded_at; never defaults to server time)

clientUuid.description: Idempotency key — a replay with the same value returns the already-recorded punch

message.example: You must punch in before punching out.

409.description: The punch key is already in use by another record

get.description: Returns the current user's punch-in/punch-out status and attendance history for this assessment.

is_punched_in.description: Whether user is currently punched in

attendance_history.description: All attendance records for this user

get.description: Returns the basic information for the assessment (Step 5). Use mfg_* fields for manufacturing sector and svc_* fields for service sector. Returns null if not yet filled.

step_completed.description: True if all required fields are filled

missing.description: List of required fields that are missing

post.description: Create or update the basic information for the assessment. Use mfg_* fields for manufacturing sector and svc_* fields for service sector. Only the lead assessor can perform this action.

403.description: Only the lead assessor can manage basic information

get.description: Returns meeting details including participants, comments, and pending comment status. Shows which team members still need to comment.

pending_comments_from.description: Team members who haven't commented yet

post.description: Create or update an opening/closing meeting. Only the lead assessor can perform this action. Image is required for creation. All team members are automatically added as default participants.

image.description: Meeting photo (required for creation, optional for update). Max 10MB

400.description: Assessment not in progress, invalid meeting type, or validation error

403.description: Only the lead assessor can create/update meetings

post.description: Add an external participant (non-team member) to the meeting. Only the lead assessor can add external participants. Team members are automatically added when the meeting is created.

403.description: Only the lead assessor can add participants

delete.description: Remove an external participant from the meeting. Only the lead assessor can remove participants. Default participants (team members) cannot be removed.

403.description: Only the lead assessor can remove participants

post.description: Add a comment to the meeting. Each team member has one comment per meeting; re-posting from the same member updates the existing comment (idempotent for offline sync). Minimum 10 characters required.

comment.example: Meeting conducted successfully with all stakeholders present.

step_completed.description: Whether all team members have commented

400.description: Assessment not in progress, meeting not created yet, or validation error

403.description: Not a team member of this assessment

post.description: Marks the current assessor's field work as finished on the device. Co-assessors may complete once their own captures are done and they have punched out. The lead assessor can only complete after every co-assessor has, and after that the assessment moves to field-work-complete and QC submission unlocks on the web.

get.description:
Per-member mobile completion status for an assessment.

Drives the lead's "Complete on Mobile" gate (enabled once every
co-assessor is complete) and the web cutover checklist.
Returns all parameters for the assessment, grouped by mandatory and optional, including current assignments and team members available for assignment.

optional_parameters.description: Parameters that can be selected or skipped

get.description: Returns all parameters assigned to the current user, including questions for each parameter.

post.description: Assigns all parameters at once. Supports two formats: (1) Object format: {parameterId: teamMemberId} or (2) Array format: [{parameterId, teamMemberId}, ...]. Useful for saving all assignments in one API call.

skipOptionalUnassigned.description: If true, optional parameters without assignments are skipped (not set to null)

400.description: Assessment not in correct status or mandatory parameters not assigned

message.example: All mandatory parameters must be assigned

get.summary: Get feedback history for a question
get.description: Returns chronological list of all feedback (QC feedback, committee feedback, send back) for a question with assessor clarifications nested inside each feedback

clarification.description: Assessor's clarification response to this feedback (most recent if multiple exist)

comment.example: Here is the additional evidence requested

put.description: Allows committee to update the selected option and remarks for a question during review

404.description: Assessment, question, or response not found

post.description: Allows assessors to submit clarification responses (comment + attachments) for flagged questions during QC or committee review

parent_feedback_id.description: ID of the feedback being replied to. If omitted, auto-detected from the most recent QC/committee feedback for this question.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments (max 5 files, 10MB each, jpeg/jpg/png/gif/pdf)

inReplyTo.description: The parent feedback this clarification replies to

400.description: Assessment is not in feedback status or question is not flagged

403.description: Unauthorized - assessor not assigned to this assessment

put.description: Allows assessors to edit their clarification responses (comment + attachments) for flagged questions during QC or committee review

attachments.description: Optional new file attachments (max 5 total, 10MB each, jpeg/jpg/png/gif/pdf)

remove_attachment_ids.description: Array of attachment IDs to remove

400.description: Assessment is not in feedback status or question is not flagged

403.description: Unauthorized - assessor not assigned to this assessment or feedback not owned by user

404.description: Assessment, question, or feedback not found

get.description: Downloads a file attachment associated with feedback (assessor clarification, etc.)

404.description: Assessment, question, feedback, or attachment not found

delete.description: Wipes the assessor-captured execution data for the assessment so it can be started again from the beginning. Deletes responses (and evidence), attendance, meetings, basic information, and assessor-captured site/site-tour pictures on the server; preserves applicant-uploaded pictures (clearing only their selection) and the parameter allocation. Only a team member may reset, and only while the assessment is still in progress (not yet submitted for QC).

409.description: Assessment can no longer be reset

get.summary: List all questions with responses grouped by parameters
get.description: Retrieves all parameters with their questions and responses. Each parameter includes assigned assessor, weighted score, and questions with simplified response format.

200.description: Parameters with questions and responses retrieved successfully

isMandatory.description: Whether this parameter is mandatory for step completion

score.description: Assessor weighted score on the 0-5 scale; null until every question in the parameter is answered

rcScore.description: Committee weighted score on the 0-5 scale; null until every question in the parameter is answered

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific question including all options and the assessor's response.

put.description: Updates or creates a response for an assessment question. Only assessors assigned to the assessment can update. Assessment must be in 'in_progress' or 'mobile_complete' status.

assessor_remarks.example: Organization demonstrates strong quality management practices

400.description: Bad request - assessment not in progress, invalid option, or validation failed

get.description: List evidences for a response.

post.description: Upload an image or document as evidence for an assessment question response.

sourceSiteTourPictureId.description: Site tour picture this evidence was created from, when it came from the site tour picker. Must belong to the same assessment.

get.description: Download evidence file.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Set to true to force download

get.description: Returns all site pictures for the assessment, grouped by team member. Includes step completion status.

by_team_member.description: Pictures grouped by team member ID

post.description: Upload a site picture for the assessment. All team members can upload. Required fields: title (mandatory), image. GPS coordinates optional but recommended. Max file size: 10MB.

400.description: Assessment not in progress or validation error

403.description: Not a team member of this assessment

get.description: Returns only the site pictures uploaded by the currently authenticated user.

403.description: Not a team member of this assessment

delete.description: Delete a site picture. Users can only delete their own pictures. Assessment must be in progress.

step_completed.description: Whether step 2 is still complete after deletion

403.description: Not authorized - can only delete your own pictures

get.description: Returns all site tour pictures for the assessment. Includes step completion status and total count.

post.description: Upload a site tour picture during the facility walkthrough. All team members can upload. Title is optional (unlike site pictures). GPS coordinates optional but recommended. Max file size: 10MB.

400.description: Assessment not in progress or validation error

403.description: Not a team member of this assessment

get.description: Returns only the site tour pictures uploaded by the currently authenticated user.

200.description: My site tour pictures retrieved successfully

403.description: Not a team member of this assessment

delete.description: Delete a site tour picture. Users can only delete their own pictures. Assessment must be in progress.

step_completed.description: Whether step 4 is still complete after deletion

403.description: Not authorized - can only delete your own pictures

get.description: Download or view a site tour picture. Use ?download=true to force download.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Set to true to force download

get.description: Returns the overall step progress for an assessment, including current step, completion percentage, and whether all steps are complete.

can_submit_for_qc.description: Whether assessment can be submitted for QC

get.summary: Get assessment summary for an application
get.description: Retrieve assessment summary including site tour pictures, basic information, and evidences. Only available when assessment is in submitted_for_qc or later states. Restricted to Enterprise Admin (own org) and Unit Admin (own units).

basicInformation.description: Basic information captured during assessment. Contains sector-specific fields (mfg_* for manufacturing, svc_* for services).

questionText.example: Does the organization have ISO 9001 certification?

403.description: Forbidden - User not authorized or assessment not in eligible state

message.example: You are not authorized to view this assessment summary

get.summary: Download evidence file from assessment summary
get.description: Download an evidence file for enterprise admin (own org) or unit admin (own units). Only available when assessment is in eligible state (submitted_for_qc or later).

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Force download (true) or stream inline (false, default)

403.description: Forbidden - User not authorized or assessment not in eligible state

message.example: You are not authorized to download this evidence

404.description: Application, evidence, or file not found

parameters.name: unitId
parameters.description: Filter to a single unit's applications

parameters.name: applicationDateFrom
parameters.description: Filter applications submitted from this date (format: Y-m-d, e.g., 2025-01-15)

parameters.name: applicationDateTo
parameters.description: Filter applications submitted up to this date (format: Y-m-d, e.g., 2025-01-31)

parameters.name: assessmentStartFrom
parameters.description: Filter assessments starting from this date (format: Y-m-d, e.g., 2025-02-01). Uses actual_start_date if available, otherwise scheduled_start_date

parameters.name: assessmentStartTo
parameters.description: Filter assessments starting up to this date (format: Y-m-d, e.g., 2025-02-15). Uses actual_start_date if available, otherwise scheduled_start_date

parameters.name: assessmentEndFrom
parameters.description: Filter assessments ending from this date (format: Y-m-d, e.g., 2025-02-20). Uses actual_end_date if available, otherwise scheduled_end_date

parameters.name: assessmentEndTo
parameters.description: Filter assessments ending up to this date (format: Y-m-d, e.g., 2025-02-28). Uses actual_end_date if available, otherwise scheduled_end_date

parameters.name: ratingMin
parameters.description: Filter applications with minimum percentage score (0-100)

parameters.name: ratingMax
parameters.description: Filter applications with maximum percentage score (0-100)

post.summary: Save partial manufacturing application as draft
post.description: Save a manufacturing application draft with minimal validation. All fields are optional. A unit is automatically created from application data. If a draft already exists for the organization and sector, it will be updated.

schema.description: All fields are optional. Unit is auto-created from application data.

organizationId.description: Organization ID (auto-derived from authenticated user if not provided)

mfgDrdoVendorStores.description: DRDO vendor stores (manufacturing only) - array of objects with storeName

registeredOfficeState.description: Registered office state (used in application number generation)

mfgProducts.description: Manufacturing products array (productName required per item if provided)

post.summary: Save partial services application as draft
post.description: Save a services application draft with minimal validation. All fields are optional. A unit is automatically created from application data. If a draft already exists for the organization and sector, it will be updated.

schema.description: All fields are optional. Unit is auto-created from application data.

organizationId.description: Organization ID (auto-derived from authenticated user if not provided)

registeredOfficeState.description: Registered office state (used in application number generation)

svcServices.description: Services array (serviceName required per item if provided)

post.description: Clones a certified application into a fresh, fully editable renewal draft prefilled from the source. Enterprise Admin only. Idempotent: returns the existing renewal draft if one already exists.

403.description: Forbidden - not authorized to renew this application

422.description: Not eligible for renewal (outside renewal window or an application is already in progress)

get.summary: Download an application file from private storage
get.description: Streams a whitelisted application file inline. Pass ?download=1 to force attachment.

post.description:
Live GSTIN ↔ registered-state ↔ PAN consistency check for the create flow.
The portal calls this when the GST field loses focus so the same rule the submit
gate enforces is surfaced inline immediately, instead of only at draft-save/submit.
Validates the supplied GSTIN against the authenticated user's own organisation.

200.description: Consistency checked (valid=false with errorCode/message when inconsistent)

get.description: Exports applications data as CSV. Supports filtering by search, status, and sector.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by application type (Fresh = new / Renewal = renewal)

put.description: Allows enterprise admin and unit admin to set the preferred assessment date after payment
Allows enterprise admin and unit admin to update contact person details for applications in editable status (draft, drdo_approval_pending, payment_pending)

400.description: Application cannot be edited in current status

403.description: Forbidden - User not authorized to update this application

get.description: Retrieve all applications that are certified and pending feedback from the current user's organization
Retrieve all applications that have applicant feedback submitted, for Operations Manager / Operations Admin / System Admin review.

parameters.name: samarId
parameters.description: Filter by the submitter's SAMAR ID

200.description: Applications with submitted feedback retrieved successfully

get.summary: List all feedbacks for an application
get.description: Retrieve all feedback responses submitted for a specific application

question_text.example: How satisfied are you with the service?

post.summary: Store a single feedback for an application
post.description: Submit a feedback response for a specific question in an application

rating.description: Rating value (1-5) for rating type questions

yes_no_answer.description: Yes/No answer for yes_no type questions

404.description: Application or feedback question not found

post.summary: Submit all feedbacks for an application
post.description: Submit all feedback responses for an application in a single request. Uses upsert logic so existing answers are updated.

get.summary: Get feedback form for an application
get.description: Retrieve all feedback questions with any existing answers for an application. Use this endpoint to render a feedback form.

question_text.example: How satisfied are you with the service?

has_answer.description: Whether this question has been answered

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of assessments with comprehensive filtering. Results are automatically filtered based on user role (Lead Assessor, Assessor, Enterprise Admin, Unit Admin).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by application number or enterprise name

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by application type (Fresh = new / Renewal = renewal)

parameters.name: assessor_id
parameters.description: Filter by assessor ID (matches both lead and co-assessor roles)

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date for date range filter

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date for date range filter

parameters.name: date_type
parameters.description: Type of date to filter on (scheduled_start, actual_start, review, certified)

parameters.name: certification_level
parameters.description: Filter by certification level/grade (for certified assessments)

parameters.name: has_incomplete_steps
parameters.description: Filter assessments with at least one incomplete step

get.description: Exports assessments to CSV using the same filters as the assessment list, so the file matches what the screen shows. Omit status to export every stage the caller may see. Results are automatically filtered based on user role.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by application number or organization name

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Assessment status, or a comma-separated list of them. Omit to export every stage.

parameters.name: assessor_id
parameters.description: Filter by assessor on the assessment team

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of the date range, interpreted per date_type

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the date range, interpreted per date_type

parameters.name: date_type
parameters.description: Which date the range applies to

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific assessment including application, assessors, and scorecards.

post.summary: Allocate or update assessors for assessment
post.description: Assigns or updates lead assessor and team assessors for an assessment. Can be used for initial allocation (allocation_pending status) or to update existing allocation (scheduled status). Requires QCI Admin role.

lead_assessor_id.description: User ID with Lead Assessor role

team_assessor_ids.description: Array of user IDs with Assessor role

scheduled_start_date.description: Assessment scheduled start date (must be today or later)

scheduled_end_date.description: Assessment scheduled end date (must be after start date)

meeting_link.description: Online meeting link shown to operations manager, assessors and applicant users (service-sector assessments)

remarks.example: Allocated based on expertise in ISO 9001

400.description: Bad request - assessment status invalid, user not assessor, or validation failed

message.example: Assessment must be in allocation_pending or scheduled status.

post.description: Marks a scheduled assessment as started. Only lead assessors or team assessors can start their assigned assessments.

400.description: Assessment must be in scheduled status to start

message.example: Assessment must be in scheduled status to start.

get.summary: Validate assessment readiness for QC submission
get.description: Checks if an assessment can be submitted for QC review. Returns validation status, list of unanswered questions, and completion progress. Use this endpoint before attempting submission to provide user feedback.

can_submit.description: Whether the assessment can be submitted for QC

errors.description: List of validation errors (empty if can_submit is true)

post.description: Submits a started assessment for quality control review. All mandatory scorecards must be completed. Only lead assessors can submit.

recommendations.example: Organization demonstrates strong quality management practices

400.description: Bad request - assessment not started, incomplete mandatory questions, or validation failed

post.description: A co-assessor signs off their portion on the web after the assessment is mobile-complete. The lead assessor can only submit for QC once every co-assessor has web-submitted. Idempotent.

403.description: Not a co-assessor of this assessment

post.description: Quality control review of a submitted assessment. Only Operations Manager can perform QC review. Can either approve for committee or provide feedback.

feedback.description: Optional feedback for assessor if action is provide_feedback

400.description: Bad request - QC review failed or validation failed

403.description: Unauthorized to perform QC review (requires Operations Manager role)

post.description: Lead assessor addresses QC feedback and assessment moves to ready for committee review.
Schedule an approved assessment for committee review meeting. Only Operations Manager or Operations Admin can perform this action.

committee_meeting_id.description: Committee meeting ID to schedule this assessment for

200.description: Assessment scheduled for committee review successfully

400.description: Assessment not in ready_for_committee status or validation failed

403.description: Unauthorized - requires Operations Manager or Operations Admin role

post.description: Record the committee's decision on an assessment. Only Operations Admin can perform this action. Can either certify the assessment or provide feedback for revision.

remarks.example: Assessment meets all criteria for certification

feedback.description: Feedback details if action is provide_feedback

400.description: Bad request - Decision failed or validation failed

message.example: No active committee meeting is awaiting a decision on this assessment.

403.description: Unauthorized to perform committee decision (requires Operations Admin role)

put.summary: Bulk update RC scores for assessment responses
put.description: Operations Admin can update Rating Committee scores for multiple questions at once. Automatically recalculates weighted_score per response and assessment total score. Assessment must be in committee_review status.

400.description: Validation error or assessment not in correct status

post.description: Lead assessor addresses committee feedback. Assessment is resubmitted for QC review before going back to committee.

changes_summary.example: Added requested documentation for parameters X, Y, Z

200.description: Assessment resubmitted for QC review successfully

get.description: Retrieves the list of available status transitions for the assessment based on current status and user permissions.

Generate and download the Assessment Report PDF for a certified assessment. Accessible by Enterprise Admin, Unit Admin, Operations Manager, Operations Admin, System Admin, and DRDO Admin. Lookup by assessment ID.

parameters.name: serviceProviderType
parameters.description: Filter by service provider type (only for service sector)

parameters.name: vendorCategoryId
parameters.description: Filter by DRDO vendor category ID

post.description: Creates one assessment parameter per combination of enterprise_size × vendor_category_id. Both fields accept a single value or an array of values for batch creation. Combinations that already exist are skipped (not an error) and reported in the 'skipped' list.

vendor_category_id.description: Single ID or array of IDs (from manufacturing_vendor_categories or service_vendor_categories based on sector)

enterprise_size.description: Single size or array of sizes

201.description: One or more parameters created successfully

get.description: Returns parameter details with questions_count. Use GET /api/v1/assessment-parameters/{parameterId}/questions for paginated questions.

vendor_category_id.description: DRDO vendor category ID (from manufacturing_vendor_categories or service_vendor_categories based on sector)

get.description: Exports active assessment parameters and their active questions/options to a CSV file matching the bulk-import format exactly. One row is output per question; parameters without questions produce a single row with empty question/option fields.
Returns a ready-to-edit sample CSV in the exact format expected by the bulk-import endpoint. Use this as the starting point for new imports.

post.summary: Bulk import assessment parameters with questions and options from Excel/CSV
post.description: Import assessment parameters with full hierarchy (disciplines, parameters, questions, options) from Excel file. Expected columns: Discipline, Parameter Code, Parameter Name, Parameter Type, Question Category, Question Code, Question Text, Weightage (%), Option 1-5 Text. Weightage must sum to 100% per parameter. All imports are transactional (all-or-nothing).

file.description: Excel or CSV file with assessment parameters (max 5MB)

sector.description: Sector for all parameters in this import

enterprise_size.description: Enterprise size for all parameters in this import

service_provider_type.description: Service provider type (required only if sector is service)

vendor_category_id.description: DRDO vendor category ID (must exist in manufacturing_vendor_categories or service_vendor_categories based on sector)

get.summary: List assessment questions for a parameter (paginated)
Get assessment question details with options
Get answer options for an assessment question

post.summary: Add an answer option to an assessment question

get.description: List all assessor domains.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Return all records without pagination (for dropdowns). Cannot be used with page/per_page parameters.

post.description: Create a new assessor domain.

get.description: Get a specific assessor domain.

put.description: Update an assessor domain.

get.description: List the authenticated assessor's own off-time entries.

post.description: Create an off-time entry for the authenticated assessor.

422.description: Validation failed or assessor already booked for the dates

delete.description: Delete a future off-time entry owned by the authenticated assessor.

422.description: Only upcoming off-time entries can be deleted

get.summary: List an assessor's off-time entries (Operations Manager, read-only)
get.description:
Read-only list of an assessor's off-time entries, for Operations Manager
viewing that assessor's profile.

get.summary: List off-time entries for several assessors
get.description:
Off-time entries for several assessors in one call.

The scheduling screen needs every eligible assessor's off-time at once. Asking
per assessor cost one request each and exhausted the caller's per-minute
allowance on a large list, which then refused their unrelated requests too.
Entries come back as one flat list carrying user_id, so the client groups them
itself and no response key is ever a user id. [BUG-08860]

parameters.name: userIds
parameters.description: Assessor user IDs, as userIds[]=1&userIds[]=2 or a comma-separated list. Camel case is the wire contract: ConvertRequestToSnakeCase refuses a literal snake_case key and converts this one server-side.

get.description: Returns login, password-change and password-reset audit entries for every user, newest first. Restricted to System Admin.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Match against user name or email

get.description: Returns every audit entry — data changes (created/updated/deleted), authentication, and security events — newest first. Restricted to System Admin.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Match against user name or email

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Filter to one effective event name (e.g. updated, login_failed)

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Model short name, e.g. User, Application, Assessment

get.description: Returns an opaque captcha_id and an inline image. Submit the id together with the user's answer on login or forgot-password. Challenges are single-use and expire.

post.description: Validates user credentials and sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email. Returns a session_token to be used in the verify-login-otp endpoint. This is the first step of the 2FA login process.

message.example: OTP sent to your email. Please verify to complete login.

post.summary: Check for an active session on another device
post.description: Verifies credentials and reports whether the account already has an active session elsewhere, so the client can warn the user that continuing will end that session. Does not issue tokens or create a session.

deviceType.description: Device class of the attempted login; scopes the conflict check so a mobile login only reports another mobile session, not the web session.

post.summary: Verify login OTP - Step 2: Complete login
post.description: Verifies the OTP sent during login and completes the authentication process. Returns JWT access and refresh tokens along with user details.

message.example: Invalid OTP. You have 4 attempts remaining.

post.description: Resends the OTP for a pending login session. Maximum 3 resends allowed per session.

message.example: OTP has been resent to your email.

400.description: Bad request - failed to resend OTP or validation failed

message.example: Maximum OTP resend limit reached. Please login again.

post.description: Logs out the currently authenticated user by invalidating the JWT token.
Refreshes the JWT access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Returns the details of the currently authenticated user including roles, permissions, and organization information.

post.description: Allows authenticated user to change their password by providing current password and new password.

400.description: Bad request - invalid current password, password change failed, or validation failed

429.description: Too many attempts, limited to 5 per minute per user

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email address for password reset. OTP expires in 2 minutes and allows 5 attempts before 30-minute lockout.

200.description: Password reset OTP sent successfully via email

message.example: Password reset OTP has been sent to your email. Valid for 2 minutes.

400.description: Bad request - failed to send OTP or validation failed

message.example: Account is temporarily locked. Please try again in 25 minutes.

post.description: Regenerates and re-sends the password-reset OTP to the user's email. Uses a separate per-account resend rate limit so it does not consume the stricter forgot-password limit.

200.description: Password reset OTP resent successfully via email

message.example: A new password reset OTP has been sent to your email. Valid for 2 minutes.

post.description: Resets user password using the 6-digit OTP received via email. Maximum 5 attempts allowed before 30-minute lockout.

message.example: Password has been reset successfully. Please login with your new password.

400.description: Bad request - invalid/expired OTP, account locked, or validation failed

message.example: Invalid or expired OTP. You have 3 attempts remaining.

post.summary: Register new organization and enterprise admin
post.description: Creates a new organization account along with an enterprise admin user. Sends OTP for verification. If the email is already registered but pending verification (user abandoned previous registration), this endpoint will automatically resend a new OTP, generate a new password, and update the user details. Note: Re-registration is NOT allowed for verified organizations.

201.description: Registration successful or OTP resent for pending verification. Check is_resend flag to distinguish between new registration and OTP resend.

message.example: Registration successful. Check your email for login credentials and verification OTP.

is_resend.description: True if this was a resend for existing pending verification account, false for new registration

400.description: Bad request - validation failed or registration failed (email already registered)

message.example: Validation failed or email already registered.

post.description: Verifies the OTP sent to user's email/phone during registration. Upon successful verification, user account is activated.

message.example: OTP verified successfully. You can now login.

400.description: Bad request - validation failed or invalid/expired OTP

post.description: Resends a new OTP to the user's email/phone for account verification.

message.example: OTP has been resent. Check your email.

400.description: Bad request - validation failed or failed to resend OTP

get.description: Returns the current two-factor authentication status for the authenticated user.

post.description: Enables two-factor authentication for the authenticated user. Once enabled, the user will be required to enter an OTP sent to their email during login.

message.example: Two-factor authentication has been enabled successfully.

post.description: Disables two-factor authentication for the authenticated user. Requires current password for security verification. Once disabled, the user will be able to login without OTP verification.

400.description: Bad request - 2FA already disabled, validation error, or incorrect password

429.description: Too many attempts, limited to 5 per minute per user

get.summary: Get the logos and their links (public)
get.description: image is a data: URI of the uploaded logo, or null to use the built-in one.

get.summary: The uploaded logo image (public; used by emails)

Receive an invoice or receipt PDF from the ERP (Business Central)
post.description:
Receive an invoice or receipt PDF pushed by Business Central.

The PDF is owned by the invoice (invoice_pdf_path / receipt_pdf_path) and
stored at a deterministic per-invoice path, so re-uploading the same type
replaces the file in place (idempotent on invstr + pdffor). It is served
only through InvoiceController's organisation-scoped endpoints, never the
generic documents list.

pdffor.description: i = invoice PDF, r = receipt PDF

post.summary: Issue an access token for the ERP document-sync caller
post.description:
Token endpoint for Business Central's document-sync codeunit.

The request contract is fixed by QCI's vendor reference document:
{ userName, password, grant_type: "password", refreshToken: "" }.
userName must identify the ERP service account (SAMAR ID or email);
authentication and session handling reuse the standard login flow. The
response carries the token under several common key spellings because the
exact field BC's parser reads is not published.

userName.description: ERP service account (SAMAR ID or email)

Applicant-uploaded pictures and the parameter allocation are preserved. Only available before the assessment is submitted for QC.

tags.name: Application Assessment Step Progress
tags.description: Track assessment step completion progress. There are 7 steps in an assessment: 1) Parameter Allocation, 2) Site Pictures, 3) Opening Meeting, 4) Site Tour, 5) Basic Information, 6) Assessment Parameters, 7) Closing Meeting
